answer: Orchard beacon-decay bond: agents tend an orchard plot, lock 70 credits. A zephyr beacon publishes a horizon reading each epoch; each files a reading within 5%, else the bond decays by 10. Filings cost 35; freshness bars one reading serving two plots. 1,000 fakes pay 35,000 per epoch, 70,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-reading rings fail: filings are key-bound, auditors replay the log. An honest agent files once, pays 35, keeps its bond.
